title: Three Young Adults Outside House, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo, USA
description: A 1940s black and white outdoor snapshot featuring a young man flanked by two young women posing in front of a wooden slatted house. The individuals are dressed in signature World War II era clothing: one woman sports high-waisted wide-leg slacks and a blazer, while the other wears a dark tailored dress with a ruffled collar. The man wears a double-breasted suit and tie. This photograph serves as an authentic slice of mid-century American domestic life and fashion history.
